1.note: Words of Ps 89:10 (בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם, "you still its waves") and Ps 93:3 (דָּכְיָם, "their pounding"). The sense is that he masters eloquence as God masters the sea. A reading "he makes the waves of eloquence excellent" (later Hebrew שבח, improve) is also possible.

2.note: Num 12:15 "until Miriam was brought in again". The edition points מִרְיָם as "their rebellion" (מְרִי with the suffix), to rhyme with קָשְׁיָם and קִרְיָם.

3.note: תֵּבֵל (world) and תֶּבֶל (perversion, Lev 18:23, 20:12) are written with the same letters. "She is as her name" echoes 1 Sam 25:25.

4.he: סוֹף הַהון. תִּמָּהוֹן ... וְדִימְיוֹן הַעֹשֶׁר. נָשֶּׁר
4.note: Each kind of wealth rhymes with its fate: הוֹן / תִּמָּהוֹן (dismay, Deut 28:28), מָמוֹן / שִׁמָּמוֹן (ruin, Ezek 4:16), כֶּסֶף / קֶצֶף, זָהָב / לַהַב, עֹשֶׁר / נֶשֶׁר. The eagle prepares Prov 23:5, quoted in the next lines. The Hebrew line "is ruin; and the goal of silver" has no full stop after שִׁמָּמוֹן.

5.note: Taken as "draw near" (to God), from נגשׁ. The form is unusual; in later Hebrew התנגשׁ is "collide".

6.note: Read as a causative of שׂרר ("make it rule"), as the sin dot suggests. With shin it would be "make your intellect sing".

7.note: בֶּגֶד is both "treachery" and "garment": "treachery is her garments".

8.note: Taken from Lam 4:5 הָאֱמֻנִים עֲלֵי תוֹלָע ("those reared in scarlet"). "Faithful (true) images" is also possible.

9.note: תְּפִלָּה (prayer) and תִּפְלָה (folly, Job 1:22) differ only in their vowels. The next pair rhymes תַּחֲנוּנִים with תַּזְנוּנִים.

10.note: 1 Kgs 17:3, where Elijah hides and is fed. כְּרִית also suggests כָּרֵת, being cut off, the punishment of the soul.

11.note: A play on קִירוֹת (walls) and קוֹרוֹת (beams). The beams are perhaps the boards of the bier or coffin; compare בְּצֵל קֹרָתִי, Gen 19:8. The sense is uncertain.

12.note: Num 12:16, a place name; here it is also read as "from the courtyards", the homes they leave. The next lines take up חֲצֵרִים and חֲצַר מָוֶת.

13.note: A pun on חֶבֶר (Ḥever) and חֶבְרָתוֹ (his company), as at the end of gate 40.
